policy.engineering_reference: Official ego_pose origin is declared rear axle in this engineering model; xy and yaw retained, z projected out. No actual nuScenes axle measurement is claimed.
policy.initial_state: Known official LIDAR_TOP keyframe ego_pose at issue time; no from-rest assumption or forced stop. No controls/acceleration/bicycle-execution claim.
policy.geometry: Whole engineering vehicle on raw official drivable with holes; same directed lane route and all-category official obstacle endpoint convex swept envelopes in every subinterval.
policy.dynamics_scope: Evaluation-only official 2Hz boxes; vertices interpolate linearly between anchors. Unmatched endpoint boxes conservatively occupy the full anchor interval. No unobserved-real-traffic guarantee.
policy.witness_role: Recorded ego future is only an attempted existence witness after checking this contract, never automatically a correct answer or a unique scoring trajectory.
policy.admission: All 12 fixed candidates retained. Only geometry/time independently passed candidates may enter a NEW geometry-time conditional feasible table, never the old main table or historical 81.
policy.source_roles: Current labels/geometry evaluation-only. Method inputs contain instruction, current/past sensor references and known initial pose, not official target identity, future sequence, annotations or witness.
